title: Junior Data Administrator
description:
Junior Data Administrator

Location: Greater Manchester

Salary: 25,000 - 28,000

Working Pattern: Fully Office Based

We're working with a growing ecommerce and retail business that's looking for a Junior Data Administrator to join its Data & Analytics function.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their data career who wants to gain hands-on commercial experience while working directly with an experienced Head of Data.

You'll play an important role in ensuring the business has accurate and reliable data, with a particular focus on stock, orders and operational information.

The Role

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing and maintaining stock and order data
- Checking data quality and investigating discrepancies
- Producing and maintaining regular reports
- Working with Excel and internal business systems
- Ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Supporting teams across the business with data queries
- Working directly with the Head of Data on wider reporting and data projects
- Helping improve existing data processes as the business continues to grow

What We're Looking For

We're not looking for years of commercial experience. This could suit a recent graduate or someone with some initial experience in Data, Administration, Reporting, Ecommerce or a similar position.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong Excel skills
- Good attention to detail
- Confidence working with numbers and large amounts of information
- An analytical mindset and ability to spot inconsistencies
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- An interest in developing a career within Data & Analytics

Experience with ecommerce, stock or order data would be advantageous but isn't essential

What's On Offer?

Salary of 25,000 - 28,000 plus the opportunity to join a growing business where you'll work closely with the Head of Data and gain exposure to the wider Data & Analytics function.

If you're early in your career and looking for an opportunity to build genuine commercial data experience, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Administrator
description:
Administrator (HR & Compliance) - Ashton Under Lyne (Tameside)

Part Time - 15 hours per week (negotiable)

A well-established Manufacturing Company requires a proactive HR Administration and Compliance co-ordinator to support our people processes while overseeing key business compliance activities.

This varied role combines day to day HR administration with responsibility for maintaining compliance systems relating to environmental, product and regulatory requirements.

You would work within an experienced friendly administrative team who share the responsibility of ensuring the business operates efficiently and within a positive working environment.

Responsibilities Include:
- Administration of payroll preparation and maintaining employee records.
- Support company policies and HR procedures.
- Maintain compliance documentation, certifications and audit records.
- Liaise with suppliers and certification bodies to ensure ongoing compliance.
- Assist with internal audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Support the management team and wider business administration.

Ideal Skills & Experience:
- Previous experience in HR administration, or
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office.
- Willingness to develop knowledge of environmental and product compliance through training.

Salary: £Competitive + Benefits including discretionary bonus scheme, pension, a secure key position working alongside senior management, friendly working environment in purpose-built factory.

To apply for this role, please press the apply button. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 14 days. Thank you for your interest in the role.

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist (Temporary Cover)

Please note: applicants must be available for an immediate start.

Location: Cheadle
Duration: Temporary
Hours:
- Monday to Thursday: 12:00pm 5:00pm
- Friday: 8:00am 5:00pm

Receptionist About the Role

We are currently recruiting for a professional and personable Receptionist to provide temporary front-of-house cover for our client based in Cheadle.

This role is ideal for an individual who enjoys delivering exceptional customer service and thrives in a fast-paced office environment. As the first point of contact for visitors, clients and colleagues, you will play a key role in creating a positive and welcoming experience.

Receptionist Key Responsibilities
- Managing the reception area and providing a professional first impression
- Answering and directing incoming telephone calls
- Greeting visitors and managing the sign-in/sign-out process
- Handling customer enquiries and complaints in a professional manner
- Completing administrative paperwork and forwarding information to the Technical Department
- Processing outgoing mail using the franking machine and TNT courier services
- General administrative support as required

Receptionist Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience in a Receptionist, Front of House or Customer Service role
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and multitask
- Confident working independently and using initiative
- Professional, friendly and approachable manner
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
- Reliable, flexible and able to start work immediately

What's on Offer
- Immediate start available
- Opportunity to work with a well-established business
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Valuable office administration and customer service experience

title: Receptionist
salary_text: £12.71 - £13.45 per hour (Weekly pay and regular work)
description:
Are you passionate about providing first-class customer service and looking for flexible temporary work?
We are currently recruiting Temporary Receptionists for a number of clients across Altrincham and the surrounding areas.

Whether you're looking for short-term work while searching for a permanent position, need flexibility around your existing commitments, or want to gain valuable experience with a variety of businesses, we'd love to hear from you.

We work with a wide range of employers, from local businesses to established corporate organisations, giving you the opportunity to build your Reception, Front of House, Customer Service and Administration experience.

What will you be doing as a Temporary Receptionist?
- Meeting and greeting visitors in a friendly and professional manner
- Answering and directing incoming telephone calls
- Dealing with general enquiries and providing excellent customer service
- Managing the reception area and ensuring visitors are looked after
- Supporting with general administration where required
- Liaising with colleagues and departments to ensure enquiries are dealt with efficiently
- Creating a welcoming and professional first impression for the business

We would LOVE to hear from you if you have the following skills and experience:
- Previous Reception, Front of House, Customer Service or Administration experience is preferred
- A genuine passion for providing first-class customer service
- Professional and presentable when working in a client-facing environment
- Excellent telephone manner and strong communication skills
- Confident dealing with a wide range of people
- Friendly, approachable and welcoming
- Well organised with good attention to detail
- Reliable and adaptable, with the ability to settle quickly into new environments
- Good IT skills and comfortable learning new systems

What will you get in return?
- 12.71- 13.45 per hour
- Weekly pay
- Full-time, part-time and occasional weekend opportunities
- Flexible temporary assignments
- Regular opportunities with a variety of local employers
- Valuable experience to add to your CV
- Potential opportunities for temporary work to lead to permanent positions

Why temp with Jobwise?

Temporary work is a great way to earn money while looking for your next permanent role, work around studies or family commitments, or gain experience across different businesses and working environments.
As a Jobwise temporary worker:
- We pay weekly
- You receive holiday pay, up to 28 days
- We can offer regular temporary work
- We have opportunities to suit different availability
- You'll gain experience across a variety of businesses and industries
- You'll develop new skills and strengthen your CV
- Temping can give you the opportunity to get your foot in the door with companies you may want to work for permanently

If you're friendly, professional, passionate about customer service and looking for flexible temporary Reception or Front of House work across Altrincham and surrounding areas, we'd LOVE to hear from you. Apply today!

Apply now by sending your CV. We aim to respond to all successful applications within 2 days. If you haven't been contacted within 2 days your application has been unsuccessful. Please check our website and apply directly for any other suitable positions you see. We apologise that we are unable to contact everyone in person and thank you for your interest. Jobwise Ltd is an employment agency and the details sent in your application may be stored on our secure database.

title: Team Administrator
company: Cheshire and Wirral Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Cheshire and Wirral Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a new team administrator role to join the existing team in CWP Adult Eating Disorders Service; 0.4, 15 hours per week over 2 days WTE Team Administrator in Stockport, based at Hall Lodge Eating Disorders Service. The successful candidate will provide a high quality supportive role to clients living with an Eating Disorder. In Stockport Eating Disorders Service we consider our admin team key to the ability of our clinicians to support our patients. They are a valued part of our structure. You will receivemonthly high quality supervision to support people in their role and career aspirations. We try very hard to understand the difficulties and pressures working for an admin team within a complex clinical area like eating disorders. We also offer a monthly business meeting as an arena to discuss with our team anything that will improve our service . Within the team you will be working alongside an experienced administrator who will support you in your role and a group of friendly clinicians who have lots of experience working with this group of patients. The successful candidate will bring an organised and compassionate approach to their working life. The Trust currently supports the Real Living Wage (RLW) hourly rate as set by the Living Wage Federation and will apply a pay supplement if the national A4C hourly rate falls below this. The role will also involve administrative duties such as electronic filing and updating electronic patient records, monitoring the service email inbox, responding to emails, sending out and receiving letters, taking meeting minutes, dictation, organising appointments and utilising excel spreadsheets, using the printer/scanner. Please see the job description for greater detail on this.The main attributes we will be looking for in a candidate will be an ability to be welcoming to service users, and to handle often distressed and distressing conversations with service users and families. We are looking for someone who is organised and trustworthy who is able to underpin the work of our clinicians. Gathering information from phone calls or emails and passing it on in a reliable prompt way. A person who can be trusted to work as the link between clinician and patient through letters and phone calls.Please download a copy of the job description (see 'documents to download' section below) for full details of the main responsibilities for this role If you have any questions about this role please get in touch and we will be delighted to help and we look forward to discussing your application. Please download a copy of the job description (see documents to download section below) for full details of the main responsibilities for this role. At CWP, our recruitment selection processes are based on both competence (see person specification for details) and values. CWP recruits people that can demonstrate the Trusts Values in their everyday life and we use a values-based approach in our interviews, which explores not only what you do but how and why you do it. Before applying, we encourage you to review the Trusts Values and think about how these align with your own personal values. The supporting information section in your application should reflect your understanding of the Trusts Values and associated behaviours and you should provide examples from your work experience and/or personal life which demonstrate these values through your behaviours. An applicant guide to help and support you through your recruitment journey can be accessed at the bottom of this page. Further help and support for completing your application can be accessed via our website. If you need any further guidance to help you complete your application, contact our recruitment team via email at: cwp.recruitment@nhs.net or by calling 01244 393100. If you have a disability that meets the definition set out in the Equality Act 2010, and you can show that you meet the essential criteria described in the person specification for an available position, please answer YES to the question: Do you wish to be considered under the Guaranteed Interview Scheme? Please inform the team if you have any special support needs to be considered as part of the interview and selection processes. The trust offers a Guaranteed Interview Scheme to any armed forces community applicants who meet the essential criteria for the post and encourages applications from armed forces reservists or cadet force adult volunteers. Please note applicants will be required to pay for their DBS check. Costs are deducted from salary following appointment. You are encouraged to enrol for the DBS Update Service.
